blocks.heading: Rebuilding a map to study it
blocks.body: This exercise tested real-time CSG and level-blockout workflows by recreating Grand Bazaar from Battlefield 3. Rebuilding a familiar map made it easier to focus on scale, sightlines, cover, routes and the speed of iteration instead of inventing a new layout at the same time.
